thread:
Marta: quick ask 

We need 3 concise competitive claims for the launch collateral and a single-slide benchmark narrative. Audience: infra/platform buyers + SEs. Keep it non-technical for the top-line, but include a tiny methodology line for the slide.

Diego: propose: 1) predictable unit economics for production workloads; 2) resilient tail latency with automatic fallbacks; 3) unified developer API across hosted/dedicated/private. Two rebut bullets each.

Rina: agree. for phrasing AB test: "Predictable cost, trusted SLAs" vs "One runtime. Many deployment choices." short subheads: outcome-focused.

Eli: benchmark guidance: show p50/p95/p99 latency + cost per 1M tokens. small note: dataset = anonymized app prompts, median 130 tokens. avoid absolute claims.

Marta: legal flag: no superlatives like "cheapest" or "always". use comparative language. Ops wants a fallback flow slide: quantized smaller model -> regional reroute -> queued burst handling.

Diego: quick rebut snippets for sales: 
- "We host ourselves": "You keep control but remove maintenance overhead and gain cost predictability." 
- "APIs are enough": "We keep API simplicity + add production observability and private placements." 
- "Cloud scale solves this": "We match region routing and offer dedicated capacity for compliance and latency SLAs."

Rina: promo copy sketches: 
- "Ship reliable LLM features without guesswork." 
- "Same API, predictable economics, SLA-ready."

Eli: one-line methodology for slide: `Method: 8k anonymized prompts (median 130 tokens). Measured p50/p95/p99 latency and normalized token cost. Compared hosted endpoints and tuned dedicated instance.`

ops-bot: created doc: https://notion.redwood/competitive/claim-sprint-v1 :white_check_mark:

Marta: action items: Marta 

- draft 2 headline variants + 90s webinar opener (today)
- Diego 

- run quick SE poll + collect rebut examples (48h)
- Rina 

- produce promo copy + one-liners (EOD)
- Eli 

- build chart mock + methodology blurb (tomorrow)
- Ops/Legal 

- finalize safe phrasing and fallback slide (tomorrow)

Diego: will ping with poll results. drop any customer soundbites here that support predictable econ.

Rina: adding a beta quote: "Switching to Dedicated let us forecast inference spend for the quarter."

Marta: great. keeping it tight. we'll iterate after Diego's poll and Eli's mock. :rocket:
